subject: general
question: Human development also involves freedom, security and dignity in life. The first Human Development Report was published in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1990**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Human Development Report:** The **Human Development Report (HDR)** is an annual report published by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**. Its purpose is to analyze and advocate policies that promote human development worldwide.
 
• The first **Human Development Report** was published in **1990**. It was prepared under the guidance of economist **Mahbub ul Haq**, along with contributions from notable scholars such as **Amartya Sen**. *Hence, 1990 is the correct answer.*
 
• The report introduced the concept of **Human Development Index (HDI)**, which measures development not only in economic terms but also in terms of factors such as **health, education, and income levels**. This was a revolutionary idea in development economics.
 
• The HDR emphasized that **human development is about expanding the choices people have**, focusing on their ability to lead a life of freedom, security, and dignity. This notion remains central to the HDR series. *Hence, the statement is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Human Development Index (HDI):**

 
 
• The **HDI** is a composite index introduced in the first HDR in **1990**. It measures development based on three dimensions: **life expectancy (health), education level (knowledge), and per capita income (standard of living)**.
 
• The HDI ranks countries annually to assess their progress in human development, offering a broader perspective than traditional economic indicators like GDP.
 
 
 
• **Key Contributors:**
 
 
• **Mahbub ul Haq:** A Pakistani economist who pioneered the concept of human development and was the chief architect of the HDR.
 
• **Amartya Sen:** An Indian economist whose work on capabilities and welfare economics significantly influenced the HDR's framework.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of Human Development Reports:**
 
 
• To promote development policies that prioritize human well-being, freedom, and dignity.
 
• To shift the focus of development discourse from economic growth alone to **social and human factors**.
 
• To provide actionable recommendations for governments, international organizations, and policymakers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **1990 as a Milestone:**

 
 
• The launch of the **Human Development Report** in **1990** marked a significant shift in global development discourse, emphasizing human-centric approaches over purely economic measurements.
 
• The report’s introduction of the **Human Development Index (HDI)** has been widely adopted and remains a key metric for measuring development progress globally.
 
 
 
• **Other Relevant Years:**
 
 
• **1971:** Incorrect. While there were global discussions on development during this time, the HDR was not introduced until 1990.
 
• **1980:** Incorrect. The HDR was conceptualized later, during the late 1980s.
 
• **1995:** Incorrect. While HDRs were published annually after 1990, the first report was not in 1995.
